tasks.content: YouAndiNotAi is a human-first social platform designed for dating, meetups, and real-world connection. Verification and identity-first design help keep the experience grounded in real people.
Built for real conversation, not bot noise. YouAndiNotAi uses AI behind the scenes for trust and safety, while keeping connection human.
Real people. Less bot noise. A human-first platform where verification, trust, and real-world connection come first.
